annotations.title: Cast a ray in a scene

description:
Cast one ray from any point in a scene: the node it hits, the point and the normal. Physics first, visible bounds as a declared fallback. Changes nothing.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/raycast"}

collisionMask.description: Godot 3D physics layer mask for physics queries.

direction.description: Ray direction [x, y, z]; normalized for you.

evidence.description: auto: physics first, visual AABB fallback when physics finds nothing (declared). physics or visual_aabb: that channel only.

exclude.description: Nodes (with their descendants) the ray ignores, e.g. the piece you are about to move.

items.description: node to ignore: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

maxDistance.description: Maximum ray length in scene units.

origin.description: Ray start in scene (world) space [x, y, z]. Nothing needs to be placed there.

scenePath.description: Exact scene to read or change, e.g. 'res://levels/street.tscn'. It must be open in the editor (any tab).
